name: a phone shows a draggable link-in-bio page
looks: A phone mockup holds a colourful personal page: profile header, social stat chips, a course card and a booking block, all stacked and clearly separate, beside a claim about dragging blocks where they belong.
build: ui-tilt-card for the phone (shallow tilt, soft shadow); each block inside fades/slides into its stacked position on a short staggered spring, as if just dragged into place.
prompt: Show a phone holding a personal page made of small distinct blocks (a profile header, a stat chip, a product card, a booking block) stacking into place one after another as if just dragged in. Pair it with a claim about full control over layout, to sell flexibility rather than a fixed template.
